title: lead time by circle

setup.note: Ma is family; her birthday is Sep 20 (yearly). Settings › Calendar: family = plan, 14 days.

input_events: The lead-time tick runs on Sep 5, then on Sep 6.
The user snoozes the nudge: "10 days before".
The planner looks at next year's occurrence.

wrong.label: early-open
wrong.assert_absent: a planning space opened before T minus the lead time

wrong.label: snooze-not-learned
wrong.assert_absent: next year's plan still uses the circle default after the user chose a lead time

wrong.label: wish-planned
wrong.assert_absent: a space opened for a wish-only circle
